messages:
Priya N: quick ask  we have a midnight perf run Fri 00:30 UTC. need 8x H100 in eu-west1 for 2.5h. can procurement confirm vendor availability and any billing/KMS requirements? :alarm_clock:
Tom B: reserved preferred for stability. if vendor needs extra lead time, fallback to 6x H100 + 2x L40 is ok but will change perf curve.
Yuki S: FYI last-minute vendor asks: they require billing_entity + KMS key id on PO for enclave-attested racks. procurement will need those values.
procurement-bot: created draft PO #PO-10234. finance approval pending. vendor requested `billing_entity` and `kms_key_id` fields. will hold resources 18h on provisional terms after PO submission.
infra-bot: quota check: eu-west1 h100 = 14 used / 16 soft quota. requesting +8 -> exceeds soft quota. project carve or temporary bump needed.
oncall-ash: if quota bump not possible, carve from bench-pool and tag as `perf-run-ops`. add `accept_fallback=true` so procurement can approve mixed allocations automatically.
Priya N: Tom/Yuki please add billing_entity (rw-perf-q2) and KMS id (projects/rw/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/perf-2024) to the PO.
Tom B: adding terraform draft to speed approvals (paste into PR):
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "perf_weekend" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  model  = "h100"
  count  = 8
  duration_hours = 3
  tags = ["perf-run-2024"]
  metadata = { billing_entity = "rw-perf-q2" kms_key_id = "projects/rw/.../perf-2024" }
}
```
Yuki S: vendor replied: can hold provisional 18h but cannot guarantee firmware parity across racks; will post firmware manifest once PO converts. we need to decide T-12h fallback.
Priya N: fallback plan: if vendor not confirmed by T-12h, trigger mixed fallback (6 H100 + 2 L40 in eu-west1) and enable `compat-mode=shim-v2` in the harness. oncall-ash will run KV prewarm.
oncall-ash: noted. i'll prepare carve playbook and prewarm script. will merge infra PR once PO is approved or if finance gives provisional thumbs.
procurement-bot: finance approved PO-10234 at 2024-06-04T11:05Z. vendor notified and holding resources as requested.
Priya N: great  thanks everyone. i'll update the runbook and post reservation link when infra finishes the carve. :rocket:
